boundary_basis: The body begins with its own D0 save at 0x001B52FA after the preceding level-object template setters.
The loop branches back to the random step at 0x001B5302 and terminates at the dedicated RTS at 0x001B5317.
consumers: The Type-0x84 presentation animation terminal pushes 0x001B52FA as an FB callback parameter before clearing the actor.
Level05_ExitRoutine seeds RANDOM_PARITY_STATE to one during its transition setup.
conclusion: The former 0x001B52FA-0x001B5317 UNKNOWN subrange is a complete random-parity AnimationVM callback. Its callback role and one-bit state publication are now represented canonically without claiming the neighboring level-object setters or terrain handler.
